entry.title: 🎥 'Train to Busan' director says AI-era audiences crave original stories

media:group.media:title: 🎥 'Train to Busan' director says AI-era audiences crave original stories
media:group.media:description:
Director Yeon Sang-ho, who is best known internationally for the zombie hit "Train to Busan," said that he now wants to make films for audiences willing to reflect rather than simply be thrilled, adding that AI has made any genre possible for anyone. He said originality, not scale, is becoming the key in the film industry.

media:group.media:description:

The film, which also stars Cara Delevingne and Diego Calva, follows him on a journey of self-discovery.
"Club Kid" emerged as one of the surprise breakout titles at this year's Cannes Film Festival, reportedly sparking a bidding war among distributors that was ultimately won by A24.
